---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a focused improvement for owner review
title: "[Feature]: "
---

Do not use public requests to describe exploitable defects; follow SECURITY.md.

### Problem
What player/operator problem needs solving?

### Proposed behaviour
Explain the desired outcome and a concrete use case.

### Alternatives
What existing configuration or workflow have you considered?

### Safety and performance
Could this affect primary-only extraction, protected storage, identity, transactions, persistence, compatibility or workload limits?

A request does not authorize implementation, scope expansion or deployment.
